sample_unit: physician-scored LLM responses (54 emergency cases x 6 models x 3 runs)
unlisted_practices: Catastrophic-failure frequency and error-taxonomy-based safety characterisation of LLMs beyond aggregate accuracy
Difficulty-stratified analysis of LLM diagnostic errors
Two-layer response consistency (reproducibility) profiling across repeated runs
Equivalence testing (TOST) of open-source versus proprietary LLMs

screen.reason: The study develops and demonstrates a benchmark evaluation framework to evaluate LLM safety, catastrophic failures, and response consistency on 54 challenging emergency clinical cases, without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment intervention.
